open_points.subject: A11-2 re-registration result
open_points.text: Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
open_points.question: Must “no project” show both an empty granted set and no active project, as A11-2 requires, and how must those two facts be asserted?
options: State explicitly that the granted set is empty and the active project is absent
Treat “no project” as only an empty granted set
Treat “no project” as only an absent active project
open_points.default_guess: Rewrite the test to assert both `granted(x) = {}` and `active(x) = none` explicitly.

open_points.subject: security review after the current decision changes
open_points.text:
Performed again on 2026-11-24, after the witnesses of A01–A19 and A22 were
bound to Factory checks of their Required tests in place of the
[TEST_EVIDENCE] notes, and the owner restated A03 rule 3 (a correction
leaves the created instant; its revision and last-changed instant follow
A04). No outcome changed; A03 is named by no category.
open_points.question: Where is the security review reopened and performed for the current changes to A02, A04, A08, A09, A10 and A12, as A21 rule 2 requires, now that several witness-bearing Required tests were removed or narrowed?
options: Perform and record the review for every category naming the changed decisions
Restore the removed tests so the stated witness-binding review again describes the current text, then record any still-required category review
Leave the paragraph unchanged even though its claim about the witnesses no longer describes the current Required tests
open_points.default_guess: Reperform and record authorization, authentication_credential_abuse, injection_interpreted_input and concurrency review for the changed decisions.

set_aside.subject: A09-1 rights-table invariant
set_aside.text: call(op) with token of service s accepted => op in rights(s)   -- A09-1
set_aside.question: Which Required test must show A09-1 for every service and every operation, rather than only the sampled Cabinet, Client Portal and PresuPro calls?
options: Add a parameterized test covering every service-operation pair in the closed table, accepting listed pairs and refusing every unlisted pair unchanged
Add equivalent exhaustive tests divided by service
Narrow A09-1 to only the sampled operations, weakening the accepted guarantee
set_aside.default_guess: Add one parameterized exhaustive rights-table test.

witness.initial: Cabinet Kernel has a valid token and names an operation outside its A09 row.
events: Cabinet Kernel calls the unlisted operation.
The current sampled A09 tests are run.
outcomes: Registry refuses the call and changes nothing.
Registry accepts the call; none of the current A09 Required tests detects it.
witness.observer: Cabinet Kernel and the Factory reviewer

set_aside.subject: A10-1 three agent-authority checks
set_aside.text:
agent_call(session x) accepted, other than registering x =>   -- A10-1
  token = Kernel and registered(x)
  and, for an operation on project p, p in granted(x)
set_aside.question: Which Required tests show the removed token and registration parts of A10-1, including the specified outside-set answer for an unregistered session?
options: Restore separate tests for an unregistered session and for every non-Kernel service token attempting session operations
Use one parameterized test covering the token, registration and granted-project checks
Leave only the granted-project samples, allowing the other two conjuncts to be unproved
set_aside.default_guess: Restore explicit unregistered-session and non-Kernel-token tests with their required refusal and unchanged-state outcomes.

witness.initial: A registered session exists and Client Portal has its valid service token.
events: Client Portal calls 'read the agent projection' using the registered session id.
The current A10 Required tests are run.
outcomes: The call is refused and the session is unchanged.
The call is accepted because only registration and project membership are checked; the current A10 tests do not exercise this caller.
witness.observer: Client Portal and the Factory reviewer

set_aside.subject: A12-2 access-version movement
set_aside.text: accepted change of x other than its end => version(x)' = version(x) + 1   -- A12-2
set_aside.question: Which Required test shows A12-2 for every accepted kind of session change, including revocation, setting and clearing the active project, both answers to a request, and Kernel replacing a request?
options: Add one table-driven test enumerating every accepted session-changing action and checking an increment of exactly one
Add separate Required tests for the missing action kinds
Narrow A12-2 to the request replacement, erasure and grant-and-activate cases currently sampled
set_aside.default_guess: Add a table-driven test covering every session-changing action named by rules 1, 3 and 4.

witness.initial: A session at access version 4 has a granted project and another active project.
events: The owner revokes the non-active granted project using version 4.
outcomes: The revocation is accepted and the returned version is 5.
The revocation is accepted but the returned version remains 4; the current A12 tests do not test revocation.

set_aside.subject: A08-1 permitted publication principals
set_aside.text:
publish or withdraw accepted => caller in {Kernel for a session s with   -- A08-1
                                project in granted(s), owner}
set_aside.question: Which Required test excludes every non-Kernel service token from both publication operations and shows the complete accepted Kernel and owner paths after the exhaustive test was removed?
options: Add a matrix covering PresuPro, Client Portal and Cabinet for publish and withdraw, plus accepted owner and granted-Kernel cases
Rely on a complete A09 rights-table test and add only the accepted owner and Kernel cases here
Keep only the PresuPro publish and outside-set Kernel samples, leaving other callers and operation directions unproved
set_aside.default_guess: Use the exhaustive A09 test for all forbidden service-operation pairs and add explicit accepted owner and granted-Kernel publication and withdrawal cases.

witness.initial: Cabinet has a valid token and an existing published pointer is available.
events: The current A08 Required tests are run.
outcomes: The withdrawal is refused and nothing changes.
The withdrawal is accepted; the current A08 tests cover PresuPro publishing but not Cabinet withdrawing.
witness.observer: Cabinet and readers of the pointer

set_aside.subject: A02-2 required-value invariant
set_aside.text: for every stored required value v: not missing(v)   -- A02-2
set_aside.question: Which Required test now shows that a project's required object address and a Customer's required kind cannot be absent or blank and are stored as written when present?
options: Restore a test covering blank and present object addresses and Customer kinds
Add those cases to the existing table of required-text tests
Narrow A02-2 by excluding these required fields
set_aside.default_guess: Restore explicit address and Customer-kind cases under A02-1, A02-2 and A02-3.

witness.initial: The owner submits a new project whose object address is spaces only.
events: Registry validates and stores the create.
The current A02 Required tests are run.
outcomes: The create is refused as missing and nothing changes.
The project is stored with the blank address; the current tests do not exercise the required address.
witness.observer: The owner and consumers of project context

set_aside.subject: A03-2 project non-editable facts
set_aside.question: Which Required test shows that a project correction preserves its project id, status, created instant and request id, including preservation of request-id replay behavior?
options: Restore the project-correction preservation test
Extend another project-correction test to assert every non-editable fact and the original request-id replay
Rely only on the Customer correction test, leaving Project preservation unproved
set_aside.default_guess: Restore the project-specific test asserting every non-editable fact and the original request-id behavior.

witness.initial: A project has a known id, created instant, status and original request id.
events: The owner corrects the project's editable facts.
The original create is retried with its request id.
outcomes: The correction preserves all non-editable facts and the retry reaches the same project.
The correction replaces the request id or created instant, and the retry creates or reaches a different result; the current A03 tests do not assert project preservation.
witness.observer: The owner and the retrying caller

set_aside.subject: A04-3 revision and last-changed invariant
set_aside.text:
accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
set_aside.question: Which Required test shows A04-3 for every action that changes a Project or Customer while retaining its revision, rather than only a project correction and the separately sampled archive action?
options: Restore a table-driven test for project correction and archiving plus Customer correction, restriction, lifting, ending and resuming
Add separate tests for every missing Customer action
Narrow A04-3 to project corrections, contradicting the normative rule and State 1's revision-and-time list
set_aside.default_guess: Restore the exhaustive action matrix, with no-op cases also asserting that revision and last-changed remain unchanged.

witness.initial: A Customer at revision 7 is unrestricted and has a known last-changed instant.
events: The owner restricts the Customer using revision 7.
outcomes: The restriction is accepted, revision becomes 8 and last-changed becomes the operation's current instant.
The restriction is accepted but revision or last-changed does not move; the narrowed A04 test does not exercise restriction.
witness.observer: The owner and any later caller using optimistic concurrency
